I thought the duck said we'd be fine!|audio = Null&VoidN1Wave20-2.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 20 ([[Outpost 16]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Null Commander''', internally referred to as the '''Corrupted Commander''', was a major boss that appeared in [[Outpost 16]]. Serving as its final boss for the first night of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It had three abilities: #The first ability is ''Open Fire'', in which, upon activation, it started shooting towers or units in its range of 30, stunning them for 6 seconds or dealing 200 damage to [[Units]] respectively. #Its second ability, ''Call To War'', spawned six [[Bloated]] [[Null Scout]]s, four [[Bloated]] [[Null Crook Boss]]es and one [[Null Pyromancer]]. All of the summoned enemies will also have their [[Defense]] set to 50%, overriding whatever value they were normally set to. #Its third and final ability is ''Summon APCs'', which spawned three [[Null Missile APC]]s at one of the entrances. ==Logbook Description== "''When the Null Commander emerged from the tear, Commander froze, his weapon lowering at the sight before him. Dispatcher's voice cut through the shock, snapping him back to reality. Commander raised his gun and fired, but the bullets ricocheted off its armor. But when the Null Commander chuckled and raised its radio, Commander's blood ran cold.''" ==Appearance== The '''Null Commander''' is a corrupted recreation of the [[Commander]]. It has purple skin and parts of its body appear to have been replaced by mechanical parts. It has one metal eye with a green lens. It wears a black cap with the [[Paradoxum Games]] logo on it and also wears a blue jacket. On its right shoulder, it has a grey spiked shoulder-pad. Various purple spikes appear on its body. The '''Null Commander''' holds a Desert Eagle in its right hand and a radio in its left hand, both of which are used to perform its abilities. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 16]] is listed instead. *The '''Null Commander''' can be taken down quite easily by towers like the [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]]. **Large numbers of weaker towers, like the [[Golden Scout]], can also defeat it. **Support towers like the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be helpful at boosting the statistics of your towers. *The '''Null Commander''' is one of the faster boss enemies in the game, making stalling towers useful against it, though as it is a [[Boss]] most forms of stalling will not work on it. **Freezing towers can be useful here as while [[Boss]] enemies are immune to the freeze, they only gain a partial immunity to its chillness. **Similarly, stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] are useful, as they still get slowed down. *There are a few curses which can be taken to help take down the '''Null Commander'''. **While [[Temperance]] does apply [[Mutation]], this will have no effect on the '''Null Commander''' as it only spawns once. This means the [[Stun Immunity]] given to towers can be very helpful here. ***If taken on Wave 20, the [[Mutation]] modifier will do nothing as there is no wave past Wave 20, making it only boost rewards by 20%. **[[The Chariot]] can be useful as it boosts the damage and firerate of towers at the final wave. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Abilities |- |[[File:NullCommanderT.D.S.Reinforcements.ogg]] |When the '''Null Commander''' performs ''Call To War'' ability |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Summon APCs |- |[[File:NullCommanderStrengthinNumbers.ogg]] |"''Summon APCs!''" |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Death |- |[[File:NullCommanderDeath.ogg]] ||When the '''Null Commander''' dies |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} NullCommanderWalk.gif|Walking animation (18 October 2025 – Present) NullCommanderFire.gif|''Open Fire'' animation (18 October 2025 – Present) NullCommanderWarCry.gif|''T.D.S Reinforcements'' animation (18 October 2025 – Present) NullCommanderCalltoArms.gif|''Summon APCs'' animation (18 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseNullCommander.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (18 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} Null&VoidNight1PI.png|'''Null Commander''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} NULLNVOIDNIGHT1THUMB.png|'''Null Commander''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} Null&VoidNight1Hour12.png|'''Null Commander''' on the game icon. NullCommanderIconIG.png|'''Null Commander''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Null Commander's''' sound distortion filter was also used for [[w:c:alter-ego:The Maw|The Maw]]'s chase theme. *Oddly, on the '''Null Commander's''' badge and matchmaking renders, it is seen with a green glowing eye, however this never appears in game. *The '''Null Commander''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''18 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0]] **'''Null Commander''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Null Commander''' has a broken icon. *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Null Commander''' now uses its correct icon. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[v1.80.0|v1.80.1e]] **'''Null Commander''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **{{Bug}} Cannot be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''4 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]]b ** {{Bugfix}} Can now be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Notes== {{Outpost16|[[Null Pyromancer]]|Wave 17|Null Commander|Wave 20|End|N/A}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
